title: Bitcoin Script for Ethereum Developers: SegWit, Taproot, Multisig
excerpt: A study of Bitcoin from the inside for EVM engineers: the UTXO model, transactions byte by byte, Script, SegWit and Taproot, and five generations of multisig compared byte for byte.

title: Evolutionary Algorithms
excerpt: Genetic algorithms from first principles: encoding a function as a chromosome, the selection-crossover-mutation loop, and tuning it to converge.

title: Linear Regression
excerpt: The model equation, L1 vs L2 loss, gradient descent, and the three hyperparameters that decide whether training converges.

title: Intelligence from First Principles
excerpt: A dense reference: the conditions under which intelligence is defined, the single primitive loop by which it is acquired, and seven ways to measure a unit of it. Covers compression and requisite variety, credit assignment, bounded capacity as the source of abstraction, and where current AI sits in the frame.

title: Cryptography and Zero Knowledge Proof Research Repository
excerpt: A living research repository dedicated to implementing academic research papers, defining cryptographic primitives from scratch in Rust, and analyzing theoretical exploits in proof systems.
